mechanics.claim: Meep-empowered attacks are consumed on-attack, dealing bonus magic damage on top of the basic attack.
mechanics.quote: his basic attacks are empowered to each consume a {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}} to deal {{as|30|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: At 15+ Chimes, meep damage also hits enemies within 150 units of the primary target and in a cone behind them, as a separate area-damage instance.
mechanics.quote: At {{as|15 Chimes|buzzword2}}, {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}} deal the damage to enemies within 150 units of the primary target as well as those in a cone behind them.

mechanics.claim: Meep damage on the primary target applies as spell damage, while the cone/splash damage on secondary targets applies as area damage.
mechanics.quote:
The damage from {{as|Meeps|buzzword3}}:
** Applies as {{tip|spell damage}} on the primary target.
** Applies as {{tip|area damage}} on secondary target(s).

mechanics.claim: If the meep-empowered attack is dodged, blocked, or Bard is blinded, the basic attack itself deals no damage but the meep damage is still applied separately.
mechanics.quote: If a {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} empowered auto attack is {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}} or when '''Bard''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the basic attack itself will deal no damage, but the {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} damage will still be applied.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against structures and wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against [[structures]] and [[ward]]s.

mechanics.claim: Meeps grant additional stacks of Electrocute and Conqueror.
Collecting a Chime restores mana equal to a percentage of maximum mana.
Only Meep cone attacks (not the combined basic-attack instance) are absorbed by spell shields.
mechanics.quote: Only {{as|Meep|buzzword3}} cone attacks are absorbed by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}}. Those that deal damage together with the basic attack don't.
